title: Core filter: rule C4 never matches a loan word in a Han sentence
description: anki_tools/ranking/coreflow.py:288-303 splits a sentence with _WORD_PATTERN = r'[^\W\d_]+'. A Han sentence is one run of word characters, so a loan word inside it never matches: _WORD_PATTERN.findall('我想喝咖啡') gives ['我想喝咖啡'], and _holds_loanword returns False. Rule C4 therefore rejects nothing for Chinese, and vocab/mandarin_loanwords.txt and the Cantonese loan list are dead data. The Latin languages are not affected. Fix: match a Han loan word as a character span, not as a whitespace token.
